proposals.evidence: DEDR5276 directly gives Kodagu ballyë great, Malayalam valiya strong/great and Brahui balun big. Survey balyadə, valudə and ballun preserve their endings and consonant spellings; source cognacy identifies this same strength/bigness family. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Actual homepage lie and kiṭak searches supplied the dictionary attestation; the upstream /cognate/93/ is not an article citation. The existing parent *kōḍ- (?) remains an uncertain reconstruction; no uncertainty is erased, and the article’s questioned Malto comparison is not included. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
